youtube.aciklama: In ASSR, each carrier frequency is modulated at its own rate, roughly between 77 and 105 Hz. Four carriers per ear give eight stimuli at once, and each modulation rate works like a label for its ear and carrier. This can shorten testing, but at high levels stimuli may interact, so frequencies are sometimes tested separately.
